data_fields.name: impact_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: effect base duration, only for impactAtEnd effects (per effect asset)

data_fields.name: shake_strength
data_fields.donor_constant: 20.0 (units of the FX layer; units not read)

best_idea: A hit's reaction waits for its effect's impact time (the donor delays the target by the game effect's impact delay), and a high-damage hit gets a short focus and shake window clamped to the time the action stays on screen.
decision_why: Keep the rule that the hurt and death reaction starts at the effect's impact time while the server applies damage on the resolving tick; keep the high-damage focus and shake as client presentation keyed by server damage; do not copy the Cocos sequencer; fix the focus-out clamp first.
acceptance: A check shows the hurt pose starting at the hit effect's impact frame while the server's HP change lands on the resolving tick, and a hit of 7 or more damage shows focus and shake for 0.35 s with the shake starting after min(0.1, focus-in x 0.5) s, nothing else changing.
